title: Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Amendment Act 2003

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 2003
ACT VII OF 2003
BALOCHISTAN
COASTAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
2003
An Act, further to
amend the Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Act, 1998
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th October, 2003]
No.PAB/Legis: V(7)/2003, dated
30-10-2003.--The Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Bill, 2003
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 11th October,
2001 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement---(1) The Act may be called the Balochistan Coastal
Development Authority (Amendment) Act,2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Section 5 of Act I of 1998

[Gazette of

No.PAB/Legis: V(7)/2003, dated
30-10-2003.--The Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Bill, 2003
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 11th October,
2001 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
3. Amendment of Section 5 of
Act I of 1998.---In the said .Act, for subsection (1) of Section 5, the
following shall be substituted:-
"(1) The Governing Body
shall consist of the Chairman. The Chief Minister Balochistan shall act as the
ex-officio Chairman of the Governing Body of the Authority with the following
members:-
(a) Administrative Secretaries of
the following Departments of Government of Balochistan:-
(i) Additional
Chief Secretary (Development), Planning and Development Department.
(ii)
Finance Department.
(iii)
Environment, Wildlife, Livestock, Forest and Tourism Department.
(iv)
Fisheries Department:
(v)
Irrigation and Power Department.
(vi) Education,
Literacy and Non-Formal Education, Culture, Sports and Youth Affairs
Department.
(vii)
Local Government, Rural Development and Agrovilles Department.
(viii)
Public Health Engineering Department.
(ix)
Communication and Works Department.
(b) Nazim
Gawadar District.
(c) Nazim
Lasbela District.
(d) Two Members
of the Provincial Assembly from the coastal areas to be nominated by the Chief
Minister of Balochistan.
(e) Two
qualified persons of repute on Coastal Affairs to be nominated by the Chief
Minster of Balochistan.
(f) Director
General, Balochistan Coastal Development Authority"

Amendment of Section 9 of Act I of 1998

ACT VII OF 2003
ACT VII OF 2003
BALOCHISTAN
COASTAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
2003
An Act, further to
amend the Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Act, 1998
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th October, 2003]
No.PAB/Legis: V(7)/2003, dated
30-10-2003.--The Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Bill, 2003
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 11th October,
2001 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
5. Amendment of Section 9 of
Act I of 1998.---In the said Act, section 9 shall be numbered as subsection
(1) of that section and after subsection (1), as so numbered, the following new
subsection shall be added:--
"(2) The meeting of the
Governing Body shall be presided over by the Chairman, in his absence by senior
most member attending the meeting.
(3) One third of the total number
of members shall constitute a quorum decision by the Governing Body.
(4) The member shall have
reasonable notice of the time and place of the meeting and the matters on which
a decision by the Governing Body shall be taken in such meeting.
(5) The majority of its members
present shall take the decision of the Governing Body, and in case of tie, the
member presiding the meeting shall have casting vote.
(6) All the decisions of the
Governing Body shall be taken in writing. "

Insertion of new Section 16-A and 16-B in. Act I of 1998

ACT VII OF 2003
ACT VII OF 2003
BALOCHISTAN
COASTAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
2003
An Act, further to
amend the Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Act, 1998
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th October, 2003]
No.PAB/Legis: V(7)/2003, dated
30-10-2003.--The Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Bill, 2003
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 11th October,
2001 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
7. Insertion of new Section
16-A and 16-B in. Act I of 1998. -- In the said Act, after section 16, the
following new sections shall be inserted, namely:-
"16-A Levy of fee, cess,
charges, taxes
(1) There shall be levied,
charged, and collected call fee from all out station vessels/boats/launches per
trip to ports/beaches/harbors/anchorages along the Balochistan Coast at such
rates as the Government may by notification in the Official Gazette fix from
time to time.
(2) Non landing fee or extra non
landing fee shall be levied and charged from all those fishing trawlers who are
desirous of fishing in the Specified Areas of Balochistan coast at such rates
as the Government may by notification in the Official Gazette fix from time to
time.
(3) The fees or charges shall be
collected and deposited in the funds in terms of section 16 of the Act, and
accounted for as provided in 'section 18 of the said Act.
16-B Bar of suit in Civil
Court. ---No suit shall lie in any Court to set aside or modify any
assessment, levy or collection of fee, charges, cess, duty or tax made-under
this Act and the Rules.

ACT VII OF 2003

An Act, further to

[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th October, 2003]
No.PAB/Legis: V(7)/2003, dated
30-10-2003.--The Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Bill, 2003
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 11th October,
2001 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
8. Insertion of new Section in
Act I of 1998. ---In the said Act, after section 20, the following new
sections shall be inserted, namely:-
"21. Indemnity.--No
.suit or legal proceedings shall lie against the Government and officials or
any person in respect of any thing which is cone or intended to be done in good
faith under this Act or any rule made there-under. ,
22. Power to make Rules.--The
Authority with the prior approval of Government may by notification in the
official Gazette make rules for carrying into effect the purposes of this Act.
23. Public Servants.--The
Chairman, the Director General, members, officers and officials of the
Authority shall, when action or purporting to act in pursuance of any of the
provisions of this Act be deemed to be public servants within the meaning of
the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860 (Act XLV of 1860).
